# Compliance and Risk Management Review Tasks

This document details the critical tasks for the Risk & Compliance department, focusing on ongoing monitoring and strategic risk assessment.

## Key Review Activities:

*   Review the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection processes on a quarterly basis.
*   Update internal control frameworks quarterly to ensure ongoing effectiveness.
*   Review and update standards based on regulatory changes.
*   Optimize processes related to regulatory changes, incorporating findings from audits.
*   Investigate potential legal risks pertinent to the 2026 strategic plan.
